notes.title: Released Input
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

   I am the developer of the game, the game is finally out on steam after a lot of time and work. The game is far from perfect and has many bugs. I understand this might bring some negativity into the ratings of the game but its fine, I want to hear the input from the players in order to correct my mistakes, with that said feel free to comment any input I will see them all, I love all of you regardless of your comment, thanks,
The developer :)
